_comment: AI preset definitions and per-purpose default mappings. Loaded once at app startup into the in-memory preset registry. Edits require a restart (v1 limitation; revisit when ops surfaces a real need for live reload). Every preset's provider/model pair is validated against the loaded model catalogs at startup; references to unknown models fail loudly. Provider keys and endpoint URLs are resolved via the secrets table, falling back to env vars. The optional per-preset 'visibility' array lists which UI preset-select use cases (each a known purpose, e.g. reason/rewrite) the preset can be picked in; it is independent of purpose_mappings (which sets the platform default per purpose).

presets.name: Claude Opus 4.6
presets.description: Anthropic's top-tier reasoning model. Stronger tool use than Sonnet 4.6; good A/B candidate against GPT-5.4 for hard reasoning tickets.

presets.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
presets.description: General-purpose preset for agent reasoning and synthesis. Balanced cost/quality; the workhorse for stages that need real reasoning capability.

presets.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
presets.description: Fast, cheap preset for high-volume narrow tasks (classification, extraction, redaction). Lower temperature for more deterministic outputs.

presets.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Azure)
presets.description: General-purpose preset for agent reasoning and synthesis. Balanced cost/quality; the workhorse for stages that need real reasoning capability.

presets.name: Claude Haiku 4.5 (Azure)
presets.description: Fast, cheap preset for reply-box rewrite actions. Targets a low-latency model since the user is waiting on the reply.

presets.name: GPT-5.4
presets.description: OpenAI's frontier reasoning model. Stronger tool use than 5.1/5.2. Good A/B candidate against Sonnet 4.6 for hard reasoning tickets.

presets.name: GPT-5.4 Mini
presets.description: OpenAI's small reasoning model. Stronger than GPT-5 mini on tools and reasoning. Solid Haiku alternative.

presets.name: GPT-5.1
presets.description: OpenAI's reasoning model. Configurable reasoning effort. Strong on complex multi-step tickets.

presets.name: GPT-4.1
presets.description: OpenAI's non-reasoning workhorse. Large context (1M), fast. Solid alternative to Sonnet 4.6.

presets.name: GPT-5 Mini
presets.description: OpenAI's small reasoning model. Cheap, fast. Alternative to Haiku for classification.

presets.name: GPT-4.1 Mini
presets.description: OpenAI's cheap non-reasoning model. Very fast. Good for classification at scale.
